# Generated by iptables-save v1.8.10 on Wed Aug 26 09:00:00 2026
# A DNS server tuned for packet rate: conntrack is skipped for udp/53 in the
# raw table (the standard high-pps tweak) and the INPUT stack is textbook -
# loopback pair, conntrack, INVALID drop, prefixed+limited LOG. The trap:
# the udp/53 accept is state-qualified, and an untracked packet matches no
# state - the tuned port is dead. tcp/53 (not notracked) still works.
*raw
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -p udp --dport 53 -j CT --notrack
-A OUTPUT -p udp --sport 53 -j CT --notrack
COMMIT
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT ! -i lo -s 127.0.0.0/8 -j DROP
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A INPUT -p udp --dport 53 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 53 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p icmp -m limit --limit 10/sec -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m limit --limit 5/min -j LOG --log-prefix "input-drop: "
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A FORWARD -m limit --limit 5/min -j LOG --log-prefix "fwd-drop: "
COMMIT
